verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a SaaS feature-flag and experimentation platform, but nothing in the evidence documents a self-hosted deployment of the core Statsig product. Warehouse Native runs analysis in the customer's warehouse and SDKs evaluate on-device, but both are adjacent capabilities, not self-hosting the platform or console.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
